fusions.name: Driving the Treenail
fusions.desc: A driving blow that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattening Swell
fusions.desc: Sends a flattening wave in a cone 3.5 tiles long ahead of you that deals 14 damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Clenched Rivets
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Rivet by Rivet
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
